AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.

2. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

3. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.

   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

8. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.

   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

13. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
